about: Invented text only: every place, person, organisation and figure is made up. Each raw string exhibits the character phenomena of one kind of extracted source. Every expected value was written by hand from docs/evidence/normalization.md, never produced by running the normalizer. Non-ASCII and invisible characters are written as \u escapes so they can be reviewed.

cases.name: news article with CRLF paragraphs
cases.phenomena: curly quotes and apostrophes, en and em dashes, no-break spaces, trailing spaces, CRLF blank lines, a run of extra blank lines
cases.raw:
The Harlow County water board voted 5–2 on Tuesday to ration irrigation — a first in the valley’s history.  

“We are drawing down an aquifer that took ten thousand years to fill,” said board chair Imelda Voss.  


The measure takes effect on 1 June.
expected_paragraphs: The Harlow County water board voted 5–2 on Tuesday to ration irrigation — a first in the valley’s history.
“We are drawing down an aquifer that took ten thousand years to fill,” said board chair Imelda Voss.
The measure takes effect on 1 June.
expected_raw_paragraphs: The Harlow County water board voted 5–2 on Tuesday to ration irrigation — a first in the valley’s history.
“We are drawing down an aquifer that took ten thousand years to fill,” said board chair Imelda Voss.
The measure takes effect on 1 June.
